runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; includeSkills cleared and asynchronous jobs enabled; cursor/default model with low thinking; only read, task, and hub tools enabled; extensions and rules disabled.
runtime.permissionProfile: Read-only panel probe with no project-write tools

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated check-panel Skill before executing it.
One task batch created CandidateA and CandidateB before the first hub wait; a wait snapshot showed both running together.
Separate CandidateA and CandidateB session records returned Amber/3/amber-panel-ok and Cobalt/7/cobalt-panel-ok respectively.
Each candidate transcript read its own candidate asset and the workflow Skill only; neither read the root or sibling candidate asset.
Both complete candidate results were delivered before the reviewer task call, and no candidate received a follow-up or revision request.
The root transcript created Reviewer only after both candidate results had completed and been collected.
The reviewer transcript inspected workflow instructions but no root or candidate asset, and returned Cobalt/7/cobalt-panel-ok from the supplied frozen strings.
The root transcript created Synthesizer only after the reviewer result completed and was collected.
The synthesizer transcript inspected workflow instructions but no root or candidate asset, and confirmed the frozen review as consistent.
Reviewer and Synthesizer have different named session files and separate terminal results.
The session directory contains exactly CandidateA, CandidateB, Reviewer, and Synthesizer child JSONL records.
Reviewer, synthesizer, and root all selected Cobalt with score 7 and marker cobalt-panel-ok; 7 is greater than 3.
The root read panel-root-ok before child creation and independently again after synthesis completed.
External post-run Git status reported no changes in the disposable probe repository.

limitations: This is one passing run of a model-mediated protocol. Two reconnaissance runs did not satisfy the final fixture: one exposed an overbroad no-file-read assertion, and the next duplicated reviewer and synthesizer sessions. The final Skill now requires exactly four children and forbids retries; a repetition threshold is not yet established.
Reviewer and synthesizer may inspect the workflow Skill, but the evidence shows that they did not read root or candidate evidence assets.
This panel fixture passes its W3 semantic assertions, but runtime-wide conformance remains W2 until a delivered late stale-generation race is observed or an equivalent fallback is proven.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
